extracted.intended_audience: researchers, research groups, and institutions seeking philanthropic funding from Schmidt Sciences
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and operating principles for obtaining funding from Schmidt Sciences: their topical priorities (five centers), the kinds of projects they support, and the procedural route (open calls/RFPs rather than unsolicited proposals).

rubrics_metrics.name: Unsolicited proposals not accepted
rubrics_metrics.description: We proactively seek out grant opportunities and do not accept unsolicited proposals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should not send unsolicited proposals; instead monitor and apply to the organization's posted open calls/RFPs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open calls / RFP-driven funding
rubrics_metrics.description: Please find our current open calls listed below. (Examples shown: 2026 AI for Actionable Matter Modeling; 2026 Humanities and Artificial Intelligence Virtual Institute (HAVI) RFP; 2026 Science of Trustworthy AI RFP; 2026 Unconventional Compute RFP; Research Frontiers Network (IIT Delhi): Net-Zero India.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding is distributed through specific programmatic opportunities and RFPs — applicants must apply through those listed calls rather than through unsolicited submissions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Topical center priorities
rubrics_metrics.description: Schmidt Sciences organizes work within five centers: AI & Advanced Computing; Astrophysics & Space; Biosciences; Climate; Science Systems.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposals should align with one or more of these center areas; each center has distinct aims and will prioritize work that fits its remit.

rubrics_metrics.name: AI & Advanced Computing priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting AI research and tools to accelerate breakthroughs across fields.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects that advance AI/advanced computing methods, tools, or cross-disciplinary applications are within scope for this center.

rubrics_metrics.name: Astrophysics & Space priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Unveiling the mysteries of the Universe with rapid realizations of innovative technology.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Priority for work that combines astrophysical discovery with development and rapid deployment of innovative instrumentation or technology.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosciences priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Harnessing biology's infinite possibilities at its intersection with chemistry, physics, and engineering.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasis on interdisciplinary bioscience projects that integrate multiple scientific and engineering disciplines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Climate priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Supporting climate research to bend the carbon curve and secure a sustainable future.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Projects with measurable impact on carbon reduction, climate understanding, or pathways to a sustainable future are prioritized.

rubrics_metrics.name: Science Systems priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Breaking down barriers to scientific discovery by supporting people, tools, and communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Funding is available for work that strengthens research infrastructure, tools, community-building, and workforce development that enable science broadly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project design: tailored programs and projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Within each of our five centers, we organize scientific support through programs and projects—tailored to the needs of each specific hypothesis or challenge.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Schmidt Sciences favors programmatic designs adapted to the specific hypothesis or challenge being addressed rather than one-size-fits-all proposals; proposals should explain how the program structure is tailored to the scientific question.

rubrics_metrics.name: Range of supported research: basic to applied
rubrics_metrics.description: Our team supports researchers pursuing hypotheses that address everything from basic-science questions to pressing problems facing the planet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Both fundamental/basic research and translational/applied work with real-world impact are within scope, provided they align with center priorities and program design.

rubrics_metrics.name: Desired qualities: bold science and deep collaborations
rubrics_metrics.description: Bold science, deep and continuous collaborations.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The organization prefers ambitious, high-impact scientific work and sustained collaborative relationships — proposals should demonstrate ambition and plans for continuous, deep collaboration.
